changesets.summary: Add Claude Sonnet 5 as a supported model.
Show remaining (not used) eval iterations in the credit balance card's progress bar, matching the monthly team credits row.
Gate the Cross-App Access (XAA) authentication option behind the `xaa` feature flag.
Fix an EINVAL crash on Windows (`npx.cmd`) when provisioning the Convex environment for guest auth.
Thread `executionScope` through the guest Claude Code harness path, enabling guest-owned execution controls for the harness chat surface.
Surface harness MCP traffic in the Playground Logs panel.
Make harness chat dispatch provider-aware and fail closed on invalid chatbox config, and correctly gate cloud-skills tools.

Harden the harness proxy and computer upload endpoints: enforce body-size limits, scope terminal tokens more tightly, and fix proxy-strategy edge cases (4 findings from the harness proxy security review).
Default Host Compare to Codex and Claude Code.
Polish the Host Compatibility (caniuse.dev-style) view: table/list toggle, match counts, and a mobile-optimized layout.
Explain why the Save button is disabled when editing a host, instead of leaving it disabled with no indication of what's missing.

Expose MCP tool-returned images through host-config-controlled model output.

Adds model-visible conversion for direct image blocks, embedded image resources, and linked image resources behind the structured host config policy `modelVisibleMcpToolResults`. Also preserves the policy through Host JSON normalization and caps image conversion by per-image size, image count, linked resource reads, and aggregate decoded bytes.

Adds host-config-controlled UI rendering for MCP tool-returned images via the structured `mcpToolResultImageRendering` policy, with `inline`, `collapsed`, and `none` placement plus independent direct image, embedded image resource, and linked image resource switches. The inspector can render supported tool-returned images for humans while keeping raw MCP JSON available.
Fix the OAuth Debugger dropping the `client_secret` for pre-registered clients during the authorization flow.
Send the configured `client_secret` in the OAuth Debugger's token exchange request.
Stop browser autofill from clobbering OAuth scope fields in the connection and profile forms.
Let organization members leave the organization directly from the access-restricted screen.
Remove the Default Host Config section from project settings.

Send `client_secret_basic` credentials via an `Authorization: Basic` header instead of the request body during OAuth token exchange, matching RFC 6749 §2.3.1. Applies to pre-registered clients across all three debug OAuth state machine versions (2025-03-26, 2025-06-18, 2025-11-25).
Keep the notifications popover open when it's opened from the account menu.
Add a World Cup soccer ball next to the sidebar logo.
Clarify prefill-vs-execute wording in the WebMCP UI tools catalog, add a `fill` device type, and document the UI-tool policy defaults.
Expose Inspector UI tools to chat agents over WebMCP, letting the agent call app-native UI actions (navigation, tool execution) during a conversation.
Keep the chat agent's conversation alive when a WebMCP UI tool navigates the page, instead of dropping the in-flight session.
Add approval gating for WebMCP UI tools: the chat agent must get user confirmation before executing a UI tool. Off by default and toggleable per chatbox.
